name: Weapons of the Faithful / Moonshot / Onslaught / Binding Eclipse / Duskwave / Sentry

cooldown.binNote: This is Moonshot's (Calibrum) and Onslaught's (Severum) shared cooldown, matching CalibrumQCD/SeverumQCD exactly. The generic wrapper spell ApheliosQ_ClientTooltipWrapper reports a flat cooldown of 9, which matches neither of these nor Binding Eclipse's (12 to 10); it happens to equal Duskwave's/Sentry's rank-1 value (9 to 6) but is otherwise a placeholder, since the wiki itself says the five actives 'do not share a cooldown'. Binding Eclipse's and Duskwave's/Sentry's own cooldowns are given as separate values below.

castTime.binNote: Moonshot's (and Duskwave's) cast time. The generic wrapper reports 0.35, which matches none of the five weapons' actual cast times (Moonshot 0.4, Onslaught none, Binding Eclipse 0.3, Duskwave 0.4, Sentry 0.25); it looks like an unused placeholder default.

Onslaught: number of automatic attacks fired over the duration

values.meaning: Onslaught: total physical damage of each automatic attack (alternates Severum / current off-hand weapon), as % of AD
values.quote: each dealing {{as|{{pp|20 to 41 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}}
values.binNote: The wiki's displayed ratio (20 to 41% over 7 steps) matches calc {9480e64f} exactly (20, 23.5, 27, 30.5, 34, 37.5, 41). The calc actually used for the damage total, TotalDamage, uses a sequence exactly 1 percentage point lower at every step (19, 22.5, 26, 29.5, 33, 36.5, 40). Stating the wiki's number per instructions; the live per-attack damage may in fact be 1 point lower than shown here.

values.meaning: Onslaught: on-hit effect damage is reduced to this fraction of normal during the automatic attacks

mechanics.claim: The five weapon Q actives do not share a cooldown with each other.
mechanics.quote: The individual actives do not share a cooldown.

mechanics.claim: Onslaught's cooldown starts only after the 1.75s automatic-attack effect ends, not at the moment of casting.

Onslaught's attacks are affected by critical strike modifiers and apply on-hit effects (at reduced effectiveness, see values); Aphelios cannot cast Phase or Moonlight Vigil during Onslaught but can still move.
mechanics.quote: '''''Aphelios''' cannot cast {{ai|Phase|Aphelios}} nor {{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}} during Onslaught, but he is still able to move.''

mechanics.claim: Onslaught fires its first automatic attack with Aphelios's off-hand weapon, then alternates.
Each Onslaught attack counts as a separate cast instance for cast-triggered item/rune effects (e.g. Electrocute, Eclipse).
mechanics.quote: Each attack of ''Onslaught'' counts as a separate {{tip|cast instance}} for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.

mechanics.claim: Binding Eclipse can only be cast on an enemy currently affected by Gravitum's slow, or on an in-flight Gravitum projectile (which it then empowers to apply the effect on arrival); it cannot simply be cast on cooldown like the other weapons' Qs.
mechanics.quote: An enemy affected by Gravitum, or an in-flight Gravitum projectile, is required to cast this ability.

mechanics.claim: Duskwave's description says its off-hand volley deals damage 'and applying on-hit effects', but the ability's own notes say the automatic attacks do not trigger any on-attack effects; the two statements on the same page contradict each other.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects

mechanics.claim: (Contradicts the above) Duskwave's notes state the automatic volley attacks trigger no on-attack effects at all.
mechanics.quote: The automatic attacks do not trigger '''any''' [[on-attack effects]].

mechanics.claim: Aphelios is locked out of declaring (Crescendum-style) attacks until Duskwave's volley of attacks has resolved, and the volley's damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: '''Aphelios''' is locked out of declaring attacks until the volley of attacks has resolved.

mechanics.claim: The sentry deployed by Sentry gains a copy of Aphelios's current off-hand weapon and benefits from his attack speed and critical strike chance at 100% effectiveness; it can also critically strike.
mechanics.quote: benefits from both '''Aphelios'''' {{sti|attack speed|{{as|attack speed}}}} and {{sti|critical chance|{{as|critical strike chance}}}} at 100% effectiveness

mechanics.claim: The dummy in this fight never attacks, so the sentry is never destroyed by return fire; its practical lifetime in the fight is bounded only by its own arm/active-duration timers.
mechanics.quote: Sentries have {{as|6 health}} and take 3 damage per {{tip|ranged}} basic attack and 4 damage per hit by abilities.
